notes: New: emotes (number keys 1-9 in fights, quick chat like Pass it / Help / Switch in Hoops, your opponent sees them), key binds in Settings, a Suggest button for your ideas, pick your grade once (Global chat is split by grade), a bigger update alert, a nicer chat, and invite friends right from the private match screens. Join codes are now 4 digits. Online connects more reliably, even on networks that block the usual link. Online fights run at normal speed again. Hoops: defense gets the edge on rebounds and greens glow at the rim for everyone. Racer: save your tracks and build one together online. Announcements stay on screen until closed. The emote buttons sit on the side now so they never cover your moves, and chat lines a moderator deletes disappear for everyone. The Pixel Pass has 20 more rewards every season (a themed outfit set, name colours, underglow, titles), your title and name colour show in chat, and the Street Shop has over 200 new things to wear (crowns, headphones, halos, horns, cowboy hats, new patterns, more colours of everything) plus more paints and stripes for your car. Hoops Story Mode is 2K-style now: every game gets a grade and pays coins (more for playing than simming, and more in the playoffs), plus goals to hit each game. Spend coins on attributes, badges and better teammates, and build rep to raise how high your attributes can go.
